scripts.title: Brookhaven script!! BrookGP mini hub 10 features (cant copy)
scripts.script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
local OpenCloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local MoveUp = Instance.new("TextButton")
local MoveDown = Instance.new("TextButton")
local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

-- Propriedades da GUI
ScreenGui.Name = "BrookhavenHub"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 0, 0)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 500)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Visible = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2

-- Arredondar cantos
local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame)
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)

UIListLayout.Parent = MainFrame
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- Botão de abrir/fechar
OpenCloseButton.Name = "OpenClose"
OpenCloseButton.Parent = ScreenGui
OpenCloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
OpenCloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.15, 0)
OpenCloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
OpenCloseButton.Text = "Abrir/Fechar"
OpenCloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

OpenCloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
end)

-- Botões de mover para cima/baixo
MoveUp.Name = "MoveUp"
MoveUp.Parent = ScreenGui
MoveUp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
MoveUp.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.1, 0)
MoveUp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
MoveUp.Text = "Mover ↑"
MoveUp.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

MoveDown.Name = "MoveDown"
MoveDown.Parent = ScreenGui
MoveDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
MoveDown.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.85, 0)
MoveDown.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
MoveDown.Text = "Mover ↓"
MoveDown.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

MoveUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Position = MainFrame.Position - UDim2.new(0,0,0.05,0)
end)

MoveDown.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Position = MainFrame.Position + UDim2.new(0,0,0.05,0)
end)

-- Função para criar botões
local function createButton(name, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 0, 0)
	btn.Text = name
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 14
	btn.Parent = MainFrame

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- 1. Speed Hack
createButton("Speed Hack", function()
	game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
end)

-- 2. Fly
createButton("Fly", function()
	loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/YWdpsfGp"))()
end)

-- 3. Teleport Cofre do Banco
createButton("TP Cofre Banco", function()
	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		char:MoveTo(Vector3.new(-254, 23, -402)) -- coordenadas aproximadas do cofre
	end
end)

-- 4. Remover portas
createButton("Remover Portas", function()
	for _,v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Part") and v.Name:lower():find("door") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
end)

-- 5. Abrir Portas Trancadas
createButton("Abrir Portas", function()
	for _,v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("ClickDetector") then
			fireclickdetector(v)
		end
	end
end)

-- 6. Dinheiro Falso
createButton("Dar Dinheiro Visual", function()
	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local bill = Instance.new("Part", player.Character)
	bill.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	bill.Position = player.Character.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0)
	bill.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
	bill.Name = "Dinheiro"
end)

-- 7. Pegar Itens
createButton("Pegar Todos Itens", function()
	for _,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace").Ignored.Shop:GetChildren()) do
		fireclickdetector(v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector"))
	end
end)

-- 8. Mini Player
createButton("Modo Mini", function()
	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	for _, part in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			part.Size = part.Size * 0.5
		end
	end
end)

-- 9. Invisibilidade
createButton("Invisível", function()
	for _,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
end)

-- 10. Reset
createButton("Reset", function()
	game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:BreakJoints()
end)

print("Brookhaven GUI carregada com sucesso.")

scripts.title: Head Remover
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeHead(character)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        head:Destroy()
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
 
    character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    removeHead(character)
    
    character:WaitForChild("Humanoid").Died:Connect(function()
        wait(0.1)
        removeHead(character)
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
    onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

scripts.title: Face Remover
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeFace(character)
 
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then
            face:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
  
    removeFace(character)

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "face" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
    removeFace(player.Character)
end
